description: Haltestellen des öffentlichen Verkehrs im Kanton St.Gallen is a dataset listed in St.Gallen open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SBB Infrastruktur. Liste der Haltestellen der Schweiz. Die Didok-Liste wird vom Bundesamt für Verkehr erstellt. Das Original kann unter bezogen werden. Coverage: Canton of St. Gallen. The portal files it under Mobility and Transport. Its keywords are Infrastruktur, Verkehr. The portal shows 1,763 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-04-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is https://data.sbb.ch/page/licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-daten-sg-ch-portal.
